mapper.select: SELECT * FROM comments WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM comments WHERE drama_id = #{dramaId} AND status = 'approved' ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE episode_id = #{episodeId} AND status = 'approved'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= #{since}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (user_id, drama_id, episode_id, body, status, moderation_state, moderation_attempts) VALUES (#{userId}, #{dramaId}, #{episodeId}, #{body}, #{status}, #{moderationState,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{moderationAttempts})
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE comments SET moderation_state = 'running', moderation_claimed_at = #{now}, moderation_attempts = moderation_attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE comments SET moderation_state = 'canceled', moderation_claimed_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND moderation_state = 'running'
UPDATE comments SET moderation_state = #{state}, moderation_error = #{error}, moderation_claimed_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND moderation_state = 'running'

UPDATE comments SET moderation_state = 'done', moderation_verdict = #{verdict}, moderation_score = #{score}, moderation_reason = #{reason}, moderation_model = #{model}, moderated_at = #{moderatedAt}, moderation_error = NULL, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND moderation_state = 'running'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM comments WHERE moderation_state = 'queued' OR (moderation_state = 'running' AND moderation_claimed_at < #{staleBefore}) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
